scope: Independent source review of EXT-D-0107 startup diagnostics; no source edits, hosted run, or native browser run in this lane.

findings: The timeout remains owned_cdp_endpoint_timeout after the existing 5000 ms default deadline; polling interval and timeout policy are unchanged.
Diagnostics add actual ENOENT poll attempts, monotonic total wait and longest read duration, then the harness sanitizes them to nonnegative safe integers. Spawn observation is a boolean.
Profile ownership verification, resource admission, child shutdown, and existing endpoint validation are unchanged in the reviewed diff.
No path, port, arguments, stderr text, or credential is included in the new diagnostic fields. Existing stderr remains reduced to booleans and fixed flags.

B_quality.test_limits: The assertions verify diagnostic shape and sanitization, not real Chrome scheduling or whether the measurements identify the eventual root cause. The two test processes emitted their PASS output; their completion status was not independently captured in the combined run.

interpretation: The added fields can distinguish an unobserved spawn event, a sparse/delayed polling loop, and ordinary polling that still found no endpoint by the existing deadline. These are clues, not proof of why Chrome failed to publish DevToolsActivePort.

coordinator_review.finding: The new coordinator paragraph says Chrome 'stayed alive' during the five-second wait. The receipt records exitCode and signalCode as null, launchFailed false, and DevToolsListening false; this does not prove the process stayed alive for the whole interval. Safer wording: 'the child had no observed exit code or signal at timeout, and no owned endpoint was available.' The rest of the hosted/native bounds, pending case states, and cited passkey/Store facts match the cited receipts.

recommendation: Proceed with the already planned resource-admitted hosted retest; preserve BROWSER_STARTUP_FAILURE and classify from spawnObserved, polls, elapsedMs, and longestReadMs. Do not claim startup fixed until native UI and cases are exercised.
